# pegainfer-frontend source

Vendored from https://github.com/pegainfer-project/pegainfer at
`1e3b6f23276b008d26b8aaba7e05fcc94857efcb`, directory `pegainfer-frontend`.
The upstream Apache-2.0 license is included as `LICENSE`.

Local changes: workspace dependencies expanded without changing their pins;
a public renderer selection argument threaded into the existing vLLM server
configuration. Original default entry points retain automatic selection.
No model implementation or model-type detection is added here.
